title: All About Spiders
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 4 complete, 76-sound stage (nd, nt, nk, ft, lt, lf just added).

pages.text: A bug has lots of legs.
pages.illustration: A small brown spider showing its many legs, perched on the wall top.

pages.text: A bug can spin a web.
pages.illustration: A spider spinning a delicate web between two stones on the wall top.

pages.text: A bug sits on its web.
pages.illustration: A spider resting in the centre of its finished web.

pages.text: A web can trap a bug.
pages.illustration: A small bug caught in the sticky strands of a spider's web.
A spider moving quickly across its web towards the trapped bug.

pages.text: A bug can hunt in the grass.
pages.illustration: A spider prowling low through blades of grass near the wall.

pages.text: Moss spots a bug in the grass.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog noticing a spider resting on the wall top.

pages.text: Moss looks at the web in the grass.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog peering closely at the delicate web on the wall.
Moss the hedgehog smiling, looking along the wall top at several spider webs.
